page_title: AI dictation for people who switch between their native language and English

sources.entry: AI Dictation - macOS speech-to-text app with auto-switching offline/online recognition and AI-based grammar and filler-word cleanup.

summary.name: AI Dictation
summary.one_liner: AI Dictation is a voice typing app for people who mix English work terms into Russian, Ukrainian or Belarusian speech, cleaning up filler words and adding punctuation without translating the English.
use_cases: dictating work messages mixing Russian or Ukrainian with English terms
voice typing prompts into ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor
dictating emails and notes at international companies
cleaning up spoken drafts by removing filler words
hands-free text entry in any text field on Mac or Windows
summary.what_it_does: The app runs as a native app on Mac, Windows, iPhone, iPad and Android. The user holds a hotkey, speaks into any text field, and releases the key to get punctuated text at the cursor. Cleanup removes filler words and false starts and adds punctuation, but is designed not to rewrite phrasing or translate English terms into another language. Speech recognition can run on the device, while cleanup runs in the cloud. The page reports its own test results: on a Russian-English clip it kept 26 of 27 English words with an 11.6% word error rate, compared with 17 for Wispr Flow and 18 for Oravo (8 with Oravo's AI enhancement on).
notable: Keeps English work terms inside Russian, Ukrainian or Belarusian sentences instead of translating them
Speech recognition can run on-device; cleanup runs in the cloud
Personal vocabulary for names and work terms
Publishes its own word-retention tests against Wispr Flow, Oravo and Superwhisper
caveats: Free trial is limited to 5,000 words; unlimited use costs $8.49/month or $84.99/year
Offline mode is rougher and handles mixed languages less well
Cleanup sends text to the cloud, so it is unsuitable for work that cannot leave the device
Makes mistakes, especially with names, rare terms and noisy audio; no admin controls for teams
